skills.name: Writing about the activities and importance of banks

note.text:
To describe activities: say what happens and who does it, in the present simple (The clerk checks the identity card. Customers queue at the counter.).
To write about importance: give reasons with linking words: firstly, secondly, also, moreover, finally, therefore.
Plan: introduction (what a bank is); paragraph on activities (deposits, withdrawals, loans, transfers); paragraph on importance (safety, savings, loans for businesses, paying bills); conclusion.

worked_example.problem: Plan an essay on the activities and importance of banks.
steps: Introduction: a bank keeps and lends money.
Activities: deposits, withdrawals, loans, transfers, foreign exchange.
Importance: money is safe, savings grow, businesses borrow to grow, salaries are paid.
Conclusion: banks help families and the country.

cards.idea: Describe activities in the present simple.
example: Customers deposit money at the counter.

cards.idea: Give reasons with firstly, secondly, moreover, finally.
example: Firstly, money is safe in a bank.

cards.idea: End with a conclusion that sums up.
example: Therefore, banks help families and the country.

questions.prompt: Put the sentences of the essay in order.

items.text: A bank is a business that keeps and lends money.
Every day, customers deposit and withdraw money at the counter.
Firstly, banks keep our money safe.
Moreover, they lend money to people who want to start a business.
Therefore, banks help families and the whole country.

paper_task.prompt: Write an essay of about 150 words in your exercise book: “The activities and importance of banks”. Use an introduction, a paragraph on activities, a paragraph on importance and a conclusion.
model:
A bank is a business that keeps people's money safely and lends money to those who need it.

Every day, many activities take place in a bank. Customers queue at the counters to deposit or withdraw money. Clerks check identity cards and count notes. Some customers ask for loans to build houses or start businesses, while others transfer money to relatives in other towns. Many people use the ATM outside.

Banks are very important. Firstly, money kept in a bank is safe from thieves and fire. Secondly, savings earn interest. Moreover, loans help people to start businesses, which create jobs. Finally, companies pay their workers' salaries through banks.

Therefore, banks help families and the whole country to develop.
checklist: My introduction says what a bank is.
I described activities in the present simple.
I gave reasons with linking words.
My paragraphs each have one main idea.
